segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several say the hydration controls excess shine and helps achieve a matte, glass-skin look, while one reports the toner made her look greasy/oily throughout the day.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most consistently praise the toner for relieving flaking and tightness and preparing skin for moisturizer, though a couple report burning, itching, or new breakouts around the cheeks and chin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally find it a good basic hydrator that layers well before serums, with a few noting it feels sticky or heavy in humid climates.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no stinging, soothing and non-drying effects even during flare-ups, but a notable minority describe burning, itching, or contact dermatitis with bumps/texture appearing after a few days.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature or aging skin report a softer, glowing look and say the toner works well as a light hydrating step before moisturizer.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature skin report a softer, glowing, firmer-looking complexion; no negative reports specific to aging skin.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe strong, lasting relief from dryness and flaking, with skin feeling plump and soft after use; a few say the hydrating effect does not last long or is barely noticeable.
concerns.redness: Reports are limited but positive: one reviewer notes reduced redness in the cheeks after regular use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the toner with restoring a damaged skin barrier (from retinoids, BHA/Panoxyl, or over-exfoliation) quickly; no dissent found for this concern.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers with breakout-prone or closed-comedone-prone skin report clearer skin and fewer bumps after use; this contrasts with the blemishes concern where several others report new breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say it calms acne-prone skin and reduces breakouts over time, but multiple others report new pimples, whiteheads, or clogged pores appearing within days of starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report the toner curbs excess shine and leaves a matte, dewy finish, though one reviewer says it made her skin look oilier throughout the day.

extraits.texte: I have a eczema prone and extremely dry, sensitive skin since I was a newborn baby. I used Cerave Hydrating Cleanser and Cetaphil Extra Gentle Daily Scrub, Cerave Hydrating Toner, Cerave Moisturizing Cream every night! In the morning, I saw a difference! My face is glowing!!! I'm a man who doesn't need to wear makeup anymore! I love my skincare products!!! :)

I have oily combo skin. I don't need a special toner—just anything that will hydrate my skin enough. This does the job. It's gentle, quick-absorbing, easily accessible (can be found in many drugstores), and cheap; a good basic, especially for beginners. However, since the toner is designed for dry skin, it does end up feeling heavy/sticky for me, especially since I live in a humid climate. I make sure to just layer it on once. For people with sensitive, dry skin, this toner will prob be your holy grail. But, for me, it's a good enough toner—not my fav tho. Hopefully, cerave will make a toner for people of my skin type.

i have sensitive combination skin and have used this toner for 3.5 days, morning and night. it was pleasant to put on - though i only used it for a short period of time, my skin felt plump after applying and it wasn't drying (though i don't think i noticed it was noticeably hydrating). i have previously only used exfoliating toners before so it was exciting to add this hydrating toner. however, on the night of the 3rd day using it, i passively noticed having some bumps/texture on my face, and the next day i noticed it was all over my face and neck (where i've applied this). unfortunately this definitely has given me contact dermatitis, which is surprising because i've tried/used a lot of different skincares, many that don't market itself for sensitive skin, so i will try to return this and try to figure out what ingredient(s) in this have caused me problems while other things i have tried hasn't. i guess this is just a good lesson to always patch test, even if a product claims to be safe for sensitive skin!

this toner definitely lives up to its name, its very hydrating and probably a little to much for me because it made me look pretty oily throughout the day, however something that does not make me use it anymore is the fact that it broke me out pretty bad, in the span of one week using it i got 9 new pimples which is more than i usually get, personally this product is not for me

extraits.titre: This product single-handedly saved my skin.
extraits.texte: I am on a prescription retinoid. Any of you who also use one know exactly what I was dealing with... next level irritation. No matter what combination of serums and moisturizers I used, I couldn't quite repair my barrier. Just the simple addition of using this toner immediately after washing and before any other product, gave my skin that extra protection and boost of hydration. It made a world of difference... please never discontinue or change this toner! It's perfection!!

extraits.titre: LOVE 💚…..(wish this came in a larger size 😔)
extraits.texte: I love this toner. I use it after cleansing with my La Rosche Posay Hydrating cleanser and it gives my skin that extra hydration, especially in the winter months when my skin in drier. It also removes any residue left behind from cleansing. I have mature EXTREMELY sensitive skin that reacts to almost everything (very prone to breakouts) and also I am very oily and I still use hydrating products and my skin drinks them up. I always used to by products that would strip my oily skin of its natural oils and as I matured learned that hydration is key - even with oily skin. 🩷💜💕
I have acne prone skin and this toner helps calm my skin. I can tell the difference when I use it vs when don't use it.
